options: Shadows move in the underbrush... something is watching you.
You hear steel being drawn nearby. Prepare yourself!
The ground trembles with approaching footsteps.
A twig snaps behind you. You're not alone.
The air goes still. Too still. Then you see them.
Movement in the treeline — hostiles incoming!
A guttural war cry echoes across the clearing.
You stumble into a trap. Enemies close in from all sides.
The path ahead is blocked by armed figures.
Something crashes through the bushes toward you.
Torchlight flickers between the trees — a raiding party.
An arrow thuds into the ground at your feet. A warning shot.
You round a corner and come face to face with trouble.
The dead silence breaks with the ring of drawn weapons.
Hostile eyes glint in the darkness ahead.

text_options: You take a hit before you can react!
An arrow finds its mark — you stagger back.
A blade catches your arm. Blood flows.
You're struck by a thrown rock!
The ambusher lands a cheap shot.
Enemies emerge from hiding!
Bandits rush from the bushes!
More hostiles appear!
A war band charges toward you!
Reinforcements arrive for the enemy!
False alarm — it was just the wind.
You brace yourself, but the threat passes.
Whatever was there has moved on.
The danger fades before it materializes.
You hold your breath... nothing happens.

You have a moment to decide your approach.
The enemy hasn't noticed you yet.
Adrenaline surges — you feel reinvigorated!
You find a moment to catch your breath and bandage a wound.
The rush of battle sharpens your senses.
You grab something useful from the fallen enemy.
In the chaos, you spot something worth taking.
A dropped satchel spills its contents — you grab what you can.
